data.name: Upgrade and maintain urban drainage systems
data.description: Upgrade and maintain urban drainage systems through capacity upgrades, network expansion, regular cleaning and unclogging of channels, storm drains, sewers, and retention basins, installation of eco-barriers, and preventive maintenance of stormwater assets to ensure efficient water flow, prevent blockages, reduce flood risks, and improve urban resilience to extreme rainfall events. Use eco-barriers and related cleaning activities to support solid-waste awareness.

links.eligibility_rationale: Drainage upgrades, expansion, cleaning, and maintenance directly modify drainage and risk-reduction capacity.
links.effectiveness_rationale: Drainage expansion, rehabilitation, cleaning, and maintenance directly increase drainage capacity and reduce urban flood impacts; results are substantial but depend on design standard, catchment conditions, solid-waste control, and long-term maintenance. World Bank (2026), Strengthening Flood Resilience in Rapidly Growing Cities.
links.maladaptation_rationale: Conventional drainage expansion can accelerate runoff, degrade freshwater ecosystems and create false security when capacity is exceeded unless integrated catchment controls and nature-based retention are used (Bertilsson et al., 2022, urban flood-risk review).

links.eligibility_rationale: Drainage works primarily address flooding. Effects on water-stress indicators depend on design, infiltration, storage, and subsequent water management.

norms.description_pt: Fixa normas, nos termos dos incisos III, VI e VII do caput e do parágrafo único do art. 23 da Constituição Federal, para a cooperação entre a União, os Estados, o Distrito Federal e os Municípios nas ações administrativas decorrentes do exercício da competência comum relativas à proteção das paisagens naturais notáveis, à proteção do meio ambiente, ao combate à poluição em qualquer de suas formas e à preservação das florestas, da fauna e da flora; e altera a Lei no 6.938, de 31 de agosto de 1981.

norms.name: Política Nacional de Proteção e Defesa Civil - PNPDEC

co_benefits.name: Social equity and community capacity
co_benefits.justification: The action reduces flood risk through drainage upgrades, network expansion and maintenance, and eco-barriers linked to solid-waste awareness. Although low-income populations are often the most exposed to urban flooding, the description does not prioritize vulnerable areas or groups, nor does it include participation or community capacity-building beyond general awareness; the literature shows that adaptation investments without explicit equity criteria may not reach, or may even bypass, the most vulnerable. Benefits are expected to be distributed in an approximately neutral way. World Bank (2012), IPCC-6 (2022)
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: C40 review changed the I Care specialist score from 0 to +1. AI runs disagreed (anonymous ChatGPT +1, Claude +1, non-anonymous ChatGPT 0).

co_benefits.name: Public health
co_benefits.justification: The adoption of the measures described by the action can drastrically reduce diseases derived from the lack of environmental sanitation in urban areas, like leptospirosis and arboviral infections, even during periods without disturbances or climatic events.
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: No C40 value: the I Care specialist score is final. AI runs disagreed (anonymous ChatGPT +2, Claude +1, non-anonymous ChatGPT +1).

co_benefits.name: Affordable and adequate housing
co_benefits.justification: The modernization and maintenance of urban drainage systems provide a moderate and localized improvement in the adequacy, habitability, and comfort of nearby homes. By expanding the network and preventing blockages, the action directly reduces the incidence of flooding that enters dwellings, preventing structural damage, property loss, and increased repair costs for affected households. In addition, flood prevention is essential to preventing severe dampness and mold growth inside homes, both of which undermine habitability. This relationship between flood control through urban infrastructure and the maintenance of healthy housing conditions is aligned with the WHO Housing and Health Guidelines, which establish protection against excessive dampness and weather-related elements as basic requirements for adequate housing and health in the built environment.
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: No C40 value: the I Care specialist score is final.

co_benefits.name: Air quality
co_benefits.justification: The description does not establish a sufficiently direct or material effect on biodiversity, habitats or ecosystem services. Climate-risk insurance protects agricultural income without specifying conservation conditions or changes in ecosystem management.
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: No C40 value: the I Care specialist score is final.

co_benefits.name: Water quality
co_benefits.justification: The action can produce a moderate or localized improvement in ecosystem services through soil and water management within agricultural and livestock production systems. The description does not establish significant habitat restoration or connectivity, and benefits depend on the practices implemented. Evidence on diversification does not apply automatically to every climate-resilient production measure. (TAMBURINI, 2020).
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: No C40 value: the I Care specialist score is final.

co_benefits.name: Biodiversity, habitats and ecosystem services
co_benefits.justification: The action can produce a moderate or localized ecological improvement through regular cleaning and eco-barriers that reduce solid-waste pressures on drainage channels and receiving aquatic habitats. The scale or strength of the effect is limited or implementation-dependent; drainage upgrades alone do not establish habitat restoration. (DUDGEON, 2006); (HASSALL, 2014).
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: C40 review changed the I Care specialist score from 0 to +1. AI runs disagreed (anonymous ChatGPT 0, Claude +1, non-anonymous ChatGPT 0). Uncertainty noted (source, Portuguese): Carga e destinação dos resíduos, conectividade com corpos receptores, intensidade de limpeza e efeitos das obras sobre habitats não informados. Se a intervenção apenas acelerar o escoamento sem reduzir pressão ecológica material, 0 seria o mais adequado.O provável ponto crítico é atribuir à limpeza e às ecobarreiras um benefício ecológico indireto, ou considerar apenas a função hidráulica da infraestrutura.

co_benefits.name: Mobility and access to opportunities and services
co_benefits.justification: Urban drainage can reduce the impact of flowing water during heavy or mild raining events to mobility systems, reducing the floodings and water accumulation on public roads.
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: No C40 value: the I Care specialist score is final.

co_benefits.name: Local economic development
co_benefits.justification: The action can generate moderate local economic development co-benefits through temporary employment and service opportunities associated with drainage network expansion, infrastructure upgrades, regular cleaning, and preventive maintenance. The World Bank (2020) identifies the construction and maintenance of resilient local infrastructure among activities that can be supported through public works programs. Similarly, the Mozambique Urban Sanitation Project Environmental and Social Management Framework (2021) identifies temporary local employment and direct household income benefits arising from sanitation and drainage infrastructure works.
co_benefits.reviewer_notes: No C40 value: the I Care specialist score is final. AI runs disagreed (anonymous ChatGPT 0, Claude +1, non-anonymous ChatGPT +1).
